What's new in 2.1.13

  • Profiles now resolve their PAP and SCD donors directly from the active base mod on every load.
  • Adds a visible base-mod profile selector with automatic detection and remembered per-mod manual overrides.
  • Profile animation imports preserve the selected base mod's sound and VFX TMB tracks.

For full details see the release page: https://github.com/ShaalaXIV/STAGE/releases
